title: Camera battery and memory card taken from locked locker

tellings.quote: And the battery is missing and the memory card is missing.

plain: Michael Herrera, who says he saw a 300-foot UFO in the Indonesian jungle, says that in 2009, on a ship at Subic Bay in the Philippines, someone got into his locked locker and took the battery and memory card out of his camera. "The battery is missing and the memory card is missing," he tells Michels, as part of his own account. If it happened as he says, it would mean someone wanted whatever pictures he might have taken gone.
